clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 OK - collection created successfully with invalid TTL=-100

assumptions_validated: Validation should occur at collection creation time
Same endpoint should enforce same validation regardless of request field name

contract_refs: Milvus source code internal/proxy/task.go:359-373 - validateCollectionTTL() enforces range [-1, MaxTTLSeconds]
contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: if val < -1 || val > common.MaxTTLSeconds: return true, merr.WrapErrParameterInvalidMsg('collection TTL is out of range, expect [-1, 3155760000], got %d', val)

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 create endpoint → CollectionReq struct (no Properties field, only Params) → handler_v2.go checks httpReq.Params["ttlSeconds"] (line 2019) → NOT found → TTL property NOT added to req.Properties → validateCollectionTTL() (task.go:460) returns false (no validation) → collection created with invalid TTL
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: CollectionReq结构体缺少Properties字段，只有Params字段。原始HTTP请求使用properties.collection.ttl.seconds，但handler只检查params.ttlSeconds。这是REST v2 API的字段映射缺失bug，导致TTL验证被绕过。

falsification.observed: HTTP 200 with code=1100 error: 'collection TTL is out of range, expect [-1, 3155760000], got -100: invalid parameter' - validation CORRECTLY triggers via params path
falsification.falsification_result: 证伪失败 - bug存在。两种请求路径行为不一致: properties路径绕过验证，params路径正确拒绝。

excluded: 环境问题 - Docker容器正常运行
并发竞态 - 单线程顺序请求
缓存延迟 - 直接调用API响应
请求参数笔误 - properties字段是文档规定的正确字段名
API语义误解 - TTL验证是明确的安全要求

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types
cognition_match.note: 命中bug_shapes.json中的REST v2数据处理模式。该模式记录了26个历史案例，显示REST v2层存在数据类型/字段映射的系统性问题。本案是同一根因：properties字段未映射到Go结构体，导致验证绕过。

contract.explicit_requirement: collection.ttl.seconds must be in range [-1, 3155760000] (source: internal/proxy/task.go:367 validateCollectionTTL)

physical.objective_constraint: TTL is a time duration in seconds, must be >= -1 (disabled) or >= 0 (valid duration)

behavioral.source_evidence: 源码validateCollectionTTL()明确拒绝范围外值，且有错误消息。不存在by-design处理负值的逻辑。

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED AND verdict_B=CONFIRMED AND verdict_C=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED (all three perspectives agree: validation bypassed)

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API的CollectionReq结构体缺少Properties字段映射，导致通过properties.collection.ttl.seconds传递的TTL值完全绕过了validateCollectionTTL()验证。同一API端点存在两种字段路径(params.ttlSeconds正常触发验证，properties.collection.ttl.seconds绕过验证)，形成不一致的安全边界。源码接地证实：handler_v2.go:2019只检查httpReq.Params["ttlSeconds"]，不处理properties字段，而task.go:460的validateCollectionTTL()仅在Properties字段非空时被触发。这是典型的数据绑定层漏洞，允许创建语义无效的集合。
